text: Assumption: The caller shall check the return value of the allocation methods for nullptr prior to dereferencing — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The caller shall check the return value of the allocation methods for nullptr prior to dereferencing — is this correct?
norm: the caller shall check the return value of the allocation methods for nullptr prior to dereferencing
assumption: The caller shall check the return value of the allocation methods for nullptr prior to dereferencing.
rationale: Allocation methods do not throw an exception, but return nullptr on failure (SWS_CORE_06547, SWS_CORE_06553).

original.text: Annahme: Der Aufrufer dürfte den Rückgabewert der Allokationsmethoden vor der Dereferenzierung zwingend auf nullptr prüfen müssen — trifft das zu?
